title: Overlays: modals, drawers, tooltips, popovers, toasts
iWant: overlays that manage focus and dismissal correctly
soThat: layered content never strands, traps, or surprises me

acceptanceCriteria.description: Modals trap focus while open, move initial focus to the first meaningful element, restore focus to the trigger on close, and mark background content inert.
acceptanceCriteria.when: Tab is cycled and the modal closed
acceptanceCriteria.then: focus stays inside while open and returns to the trigger on close

acceptanceCriteria.description: Modals close on Escape and on an explicit close control; destructive-intent modals do not close on backdrop click.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an open modal of each intent
acceptanceCriteria.when: Escape, close control, and backdrop are tried
acceptanceCriteria.then: dismissal follows the declared per-intent rules

acceptanceCriteria.description: Drawers animate from the appropriate edge using motion tokens, share the modal focus and dismissal contract, and are sized per breakpoint (full-width at 360).
acceptanceCriteria.given: an open drawer at each breakpoint
acceptanceCriteria.then: sizing, focus, and dismissal follow the contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: Tooltips appear on hover and on keyboard focus, disappear on blur and Escape, carry no interactive content, and are exposed via aria-describedby.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the tooltip shows, is announced, and dismisses on Escape

acceptanceCriteria.description: Popovers with interactive content receive focus on open, return it on close, close on Escape and outside click, and reposition to stay within the viewport.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an open popover near a viewport edge
acceptanceCriteria.then: it remains fully visible and follows the focus contract

acceptanceCriteria.description: Toasts render in one shell-owned region, auto-dismiss on a motion-token duration, pause dismissal on hover and focus, and are announced via a live region without stealing focus.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an action that raises a toast
acceptanceCriteria.then: it announces politely, never takes focus, and pauses on hover

acceptanceCriteria.description: Toasts never carry the only path to an action; anything actionable from a toast is also reachable from a persistent surface.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the same action remains reachable elsewhere

acceptanceCriteria.description: Stacked overlays dismiss strictly topmost-first on Escape.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a popover open above a modal
acceptanceCriteria.then: the popover closes first, then the modal

acceptanceCriteria.description: All overlays derive surface, elevation, and backdrop styling from tokens and render correctly in both themes.
acceptanceCriteria.given: each overlay type in both themes
acceptanceCriteria.then: styling is token-driven with no theme-specific defects
